Subject: Renewal MAP — onboarding, usage review & stakeholder handoff

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time last week. As we discussed during renewal planning, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) to make the next 6 weeks predictable for both teams and surface any gaps early. The objective: confirm success criteria for the renewal, review recent usage patterns, and align owners for the evaluation/ops items so we can close by the end of Q4.

High-level proposed milestones (timeline is flexible):
- Week 0 (this week): MAP signoff & stakeholder alignment
- Week 1–2: usage deep-dive + feature gap list (technical working session)
- Week 3: commercial review (pricing/uptick options)
- Week 4–5: procurement & contract revisions
- By 2026-12-20: final sign/commit (target renewal date)

Internal owners from our side:
- Account Exec: me (Laura) — overall coordination, commercial
- CSM: Marcus Lin — onboarding/usage/ops contact
- Solutions Eng: Jasmine Liu — technical eval & deep-dive

Requested from GreenGrid: primary renewal contact + any procurement/security contacts you want on the thread, and the preferred target date for completion. I attached a quick snapshot of your last 90-day usage and a draft MAP doc for comments.

Proposed next step: 30-min kickoff this Thursday 11/5 at 1:00pm PT or Friday 11/6 at 10:00am PT — which works for you and Tom?

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0183

Attachments:
- 20261105-greengrid-current-usage.csv (CSV summary of tokens & endpoints)
- renewal-map-greengrid-v1.pdf (draft MAP — owners & milestones)

Subject: Re: Renewal MAP — onboarding, usage review & stakeholder handoff

Laura —

Thanks for the clear plan and the usage file. Tom and I reviewed the dates and the timeline looks reasonable. Please add our procurement lead (Tom) and our Head of Security if we need SOC/architecture artifacts. For the kickoff, Friday 11/6 at 10:00am PT works best for us.

A couple of notes from our side:
- We want to understand regression monitoring around prompt changes (recent incident in mid-September) — will Jasmine lead that piece?
- We have an internal goal to increase the number of private-model seats and raise monthly committed tokens if the cost per 1M tokens is improved; happy to discuss upsell paths during commercial review.
- Our PO will need the contract language for data residency and audit logs; procurement will ask for initial redlines early in Week 3.

Looking forward to the kickoff on Friday. Can you include the Doc that lists the timeline/tasks so Tom can share with procurement?

Best,
Samantha
Director, Platform Services
GreenGrid Energy
